# statusdrift_status_page_section (Resource)

Manages a StatusDrift status page section.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "statusdrift_status_page_section" "api" {
  status_page_id = statusdrift_status_page.public.id
  name           = "API Services"
  description    = "Core API endpoints"
  position       = 0
  expanded       = true
  enabled        = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the section.
- `status_page_id` (Number) The ID of the status page this section belongs to.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the section.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the section is enabled.
- `expanded` (Boolean) Whether the section is expanded by default.
- `position` (Number) The display position of the section (0 or greater).

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the status page section.
